base_prompt:
SPRITE for a comedic browser game, full body, transparent background (real alpha channel), no ground shadow, no glow, no text, no watermark, ONE character only, nothing cropped (head to feet fully visible, feet at the bottom of the canvas), centered, portrait orientation about 2:3.
CONSISTENCY (very important): the attached reference image is the approved design of THIS character. Draw the SAME character (same face, hair, outfit, colors, proportions, outline thickness, rendering style) at the same scale and framing as the reference, only changing the pose/expression described below. Do not add props that are not mentioned. Do not change the outfit.

jobs.name: kid_good_a_idle_2
jobs.prompt: Same happy kid waving: one arm raised high waving the mitten, the other arm raised lower to the side, still smiling, halo above the head.

jobs.name: kid_good_a_happy
jobs.prompt: Overjoyed after receiving a present: eyes closed in a big laughing arc, mouth wide open in delighted laughter, both arms thrown straight up in the air, feet slightly off the ground jumping. The golden halo above the head is kept.

jobs.name: kid_good_a_cry
jobs.prompt: Heartbroken because someone threw a lump of COAL at him: the face, hat, scarf and coat are smudged with black coal soot, eyes squeezed shut with big streams of tears, mouth wide open wailing, both mittens rubbing the eyes. NO halo anymore.
